desc: Půldřep, mudry u hrudi, dupání se zvonky, výpad na patu, namaste s úsměvem.
desc_en: Half-squat, mudras at the chest, stamping with ankle bells, a lunge onto the heel, namaste with a smile.

beats.prompt: she sinks into a deep half-squat with knees bent outward and arms held level, and holds the pose
she forms precise mudra hand gestures near her chest as her head moves rhythmically side to side, and ends with hands joined at the chest
she stamps her feet sharply three times, ankle bells ringing, and ends with feet together
she extends one leg forward onto its heel, gaze following her outstretched fingertips, and holds the line
she brings her palms together in front of her chest in a namaste gesture, smiles peacefully at the camera, and holds
